status: Engineering implementation verified; complete corpus and scientific usability are not accepted
scope: Offline compile-assisted LaTeX preparation only; zero model calls, no scientific extraction, workspace migration or original database writes
criteria: Ready requires successful original native compilation, complete supported source conversion and reference bindings, independent source fidelity, and normalized LaTeX syntax/recompilation checks. An observed PDF-text mismatch blocks ready. Missing pdftotext is explicit and is not text-equality evidence.

normalization_scope.copied: Author class, packages, definitions, tables, assets, comments and unknown macros remain. Unresolved structural limitations remain partial.
normalization_scope.math: Dollar delimiters outside macro/group arguments only; mathematics inside arguments retains its authored spelling.
normalization_scope.citations: Only uniquely declared preamble newcommand wrappers with resolved runtime keys; preserve the complete replacement body.
normalization_scope.bibliography: Inline consumed classic BBL only for article/report/book with a single bibliography scope. Preserve deferred RevTeX, Biblatex and Multibib calls. Incomplete source syntax disables all format rewrites.
normalization_scope.mapping: Every input/output character range is copied or an independently checked format/compiled-bibliography edit. content.json ranges continue to refer to entry.tex.
normalization_scope.roundtrip: Use the same engine and support files. Compare per-page non-whitespace PDF text when pdftotext is available; this does not prove pixel or mathematical equivalence.
normalization_scope.conditions: Raw guards and post-document tails remain in both source views. Length-preserving parse masking covers narrow literal-false guards and recognized unexecuted tails; inactive ranges and guard classifications remain explicit. Unknown body branches stay partial.
normalization_scope.namespaces: Root AUX closure, external-document AUX metadata, bibunits and multibib are separate. AUX-confirmed literal citation/label wrappers and uniquely matched generated footnotes retain source origins.
normalization_scope.grammar: Learn position-bound literal macro argument signatures and declaration aliases without executing replacement bodies; braket has a fixed one-argument grammar adapter.
normalization_scope.compatibility: Only the pinned Quantumarticle 4.2 class hash and observed missing afterenddocument hook trigger the recorded empty-hook build preamble. Original source and class bytes remain unchanged.

comparison.note: Same frozen public corpus, entry overrides, support files, and gates. Ready still requires native compilation and a normalized round trip. Counts are mechanical preparation coverage, not scientific extraction accuracy.
